subject: Pen test follow-up: clarification on session/token & keystore remediation evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordanm@atlasfinance.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Security Team <sec-team@atlasfinance.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test follow-up: need clarification on session/token & keystore evidence

Hannah — thanks for the quick call earlier. We reviewed the draft pen test report and have two high-priority asks before we can sign off: 

1) Several findings reference session token reuse and potential replay across public API endpoints — can you confirm which services (hostnames / routes) were patched and what tests you ran to validate the fix? We need the request traces or test scripts used.

2) The report states the keystore was rotated and KMS integrated, but the evidence bundle only shows the rotation plan. Please provide artifacts that demonstrate rotation occurred (audit logs, key IDs before/after, and a timeline).

Can you send an ETA for artifacts and any additional remediation steps? Our SOC team is on a tight schedule; would appreciate a response by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
Security Ops — Atlas Financial

--
Attachment: pen-test-report-draft-Atlas-0423.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordanm@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: need clarification on session/token & keystore evidence

Jordan — thanks for flagging this. Looping in Irene (Security) and Ben (Platform) to confirm the artifacts and test outputs. High level answers here, detailed items below and we will upload the evidence bundle to the secure drive link by Monday morning: https://redwood-drive.company.com/Atlas/pen-test-evidence-0427

- Session token/replay: fixes applied to the public chat and generate endpoints (api.redwood.ai/v1/chat and /v1/generate). We deployed a fix to enforce single-use session nonce + rotation of session tokens on credential refresh flows.
- Tests: we ran automated replay tests (pytest harness + curl-based recorder) and some targeted fuzzing against path parameters — Ben will paste exact test logs.
- Keystore rotation: rotation executed on 2027-04-14 via KMS (AWS-KMS) with new key alias redwood/atlas-prod/20270414. Irene will provide the KMS audit entries and proof of key usage change.

We expect to have full artifacts (logs, sanitized traces, key rotation audit) uploaded by Monday 04/19 09:00 PT. If you need earlier access to a partial bundle (session test logs) we can share by tomorrow EOD.

Hannah
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordanm@atlasfinance.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: need clarification on session/token & keystore evidence

Jordan — quick technical update and included snippets below. We sanitized PII and removed full request payloads; if you want a secure ephemeral access token to pull raw traces we can issue one.

What we changed:
- Enforcement of nonce-per-session for /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Nonces are stored in an in-memory cache with TTL=30s and a backend check against a short-lived denylist to prevent replay within 5 minutes.
- Token refresh path now issues a new session_token_id and increments key_version on the client-facing JWT.

Tests performed (artifacts attached):
- replay_tests/ (pytest harness) — pass (0/200 replays succeeded)
- fuzz_session_replay.log — shows attempts and blocked responses (403) for replay attempts
- integration_trace_excerpt.txt — example request/response exchange with nonces and denylist hit

Keystore rotation evidence (attached doc and KMS audit snippet):
- keystore-rotation-plan-v2.docx — plan and runbook (pre-rotation checks, rollback steps)
- kms-audit-20270414.csv — shows CreateKey/DisableKey/UpdateAlias events and key IDs (redwood-oldkey-123, redwood-newkey-789)

ETA and delivery plan:
- Session/replay test artifacts: attaching session-token-test-results.zip in this thread (sanitized).
- KMS audit export and rotation evidence: uploaded to the drive link Hannah shared; will also attach a CSV export by EOD Monday.

If you need a signed attestation from our SOC team for this work, let us know and Irene can produce it.

Ben Carter
Staff Software Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: session-token-test-results.zip (zip, 2.1MB)
